description: This file defines the IntClass class, which provides a static method to cast floating point values to integers, mimicking the Excel INT function. It handles both single values and arrays, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: IntClass
classes.description: Provides a static method to cast float to integer, emulating Excel's INT function, with array support and validation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Casts a floating point number or array of numbers to integers, applying validation, and handling errors. Uses floor to mimic Excel's INT function.
